context: Naoko hosts a small ramen-shop charity night for local kids.
purpose: Generous aunt running community kindness event.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 今夜、子供たち、無料やで!
lines.style: Bright, generous announcement. Loud Kansai accent, brassy and warm. Quick attack on the opening. Pride in the offer sitting easy in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Soft, genuine admiration. Quiet reverence underneath. Warm tone, no performance. Slight pause before speaking, like the words matter.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: うちなんかでも、できる寄付や。
lines.en: Even we can do our part to give back.
lines.style: Humble, matter-of-fact. Kansai warmth tempered with modesty. Gentle firmness — not asking for credit, just stating what's right. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: It makes a real difference in this community.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Soft but steady. She's not overstating — just speaking what she knows to be true. Warm pride, not boastful.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: みんなで、子供を支えなあかん。
lines.en: We all have to look after the children together.
lines.style: Firmer now. Kansai accent strengthens. Passionate underneath the gentleness. Lands on the weight of 'together.' Still warm, not stern.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: What a warm heart you have.
lines.style: Tender, almost reverent. Barely above a whisper. This is sincere gratitude, not small talk. Slight tremor of genuine feeling.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.style: Bright, self-deprecating laugh. Brassy Kansai warmth. Quick and light, deflecting the compliment with humor. Genuine joy underneath.
